use serde::Serialize;
use vize_atelier_core::TemplateSyntaxMode;
use vize_atelier_sfc::{
    SfcCompileResult, SfcError, SfcScriptOutputMode, compile_sfc,
    compile_sfc_for_adapter_with_experimental_options,
    compile_sfc_with_template_syntax_and_codegen_options, parse_sfc,
};
use vize_l0::profiler::global_profiler;

use super::profile::{self, Profile, Request};

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct Observation {
    schema: u16,
    profile: Profile,
    phase: &'static str,
    // Serialize the actual public Result directly: no field projection or synthesized payload.
    result: Result<SfcCompileResult, SfcError>,
    provenance: Provenance,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct Provenance {
    scope: &'static str,
    retained_dom_verified: bool,
    counters: Vec<Counter>,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct Counter {
    name: &'static str,
    samples: u64,
    total: u64,
    average: f64,
    min: u64,
    max: u64,
}

struct ResetProfiler;

impl Drop for ResetProfiler {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let profiler = global_profiler();
        profiler.disable();
        profiler.clear();
    }
}

pub fn run(request: Request) -> Result<Observation, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let validated = profile::validate(request)?;
    let profiler = global_profiler();
    profiler.disable();
    profiler.clear();
    let _reset = ResetProfiler;
    let profile = validated.request.profile;
    let descriptor = parse_sfc(validated.request.source.as_str(), validated.descriptor);
    let (phase, result) = match descriptor {
        Err(error) => ("parse", Err(error)),
        Ok(descriptor) => {
            profiler.enable();
            let result = vize_atelier_dom::differential::with_legacy_lane(|| match profile {
                Profile::SeparateTemplateAuthoredRenderBinding
                | Profile::ImportedComponentBeforeProp
                | Profile::DynamicLoopRefFor => compile_sfc_for_adapter_with_experimental_options(
                    &descriptor,
                    validated.compile,
                    TemplateSyntaxMode::Standard,
                    validated.custom_elements,
                    validated.codegen,
                    SfcScriptOutputMode::SeparateTemplate,
                    validated.experimental,
                ),
                Profile::DualScriptInlineTypeOnlyImports
                | Profile::ComputedComponentUnref
                | Profile::CustomDirectiveChildPatch
                | Profile::ScopedCssVBind => compile_sfc(&descriptor, validated.compile),
                Profile::StructuredSfcSourceMap => {
                    compile_sfc_with_template_syntax_and_codegen_options(
                        &descriptor,
                        validated.compile,
                        TemplateSyntaxMode::Standard,
                        validated.codegen,
                    )
                }
            });
            profiler.disable();
            ("compile", result)
        }
    };
    let counters = profiler
        .counter_summary()
        .entries
        .into_iter()
        .map(|entry| Counter {
            name: entry.name,
            samples: entry.samples,
            total: entry.total,
            average: entry.average,
            min: entry.min,
            max: entry.max,
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let selections = counters
        .iter()
        .filter(|counter| counter.name.starts_with("davinci.s2_dom."))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let retained_dom_verified = matches!(selections.as_slice(), [counter]
        if counter.name == "davinci.s2_dom.legacy.forced"
            && counter.samples == 1 && counter.total == 1 && counter.min == 1 && counter.max == 1);
    Ok(Observation {
        schema: 1,
        profile,
        phase,
        result,
        provenance: Provenance {
            scope: "retained DOM only; no native L4 acceptance or whole compiler replacement proof",
            retained_dom_verified,
            counters,
        },
    })
}
